demo.title: hey-research.sh
demo.code:
# Who is building this Robinhood Chain token? One public call, no key
curl -s "https://heyresearch.xyz/api/v1/scan?chain=4663&token=<0x address>"

# Find a project by name or $TICKER, then ask if it is still building
curl -s "https://heyresearch.xyz/api/projects?q=<name or ticker>&limit=5"
curl -s "https://heyresearch.xyz/api/agent/builder_status?project=<slug>"

# What shipped on Robinhood Chain this week
curl -s "https://heyresearch.xyz/api/agent/what_changed?days=7&building=only"

setup: No key, account or wallet: every read is a public GET to https://heyresearch.xyz
